[[File:Sentry Point.jpg|thumb|Sentry Point.]]

'''Sentry Point''' is a [[scout tower]] built by [[Theramore (nation)|Theramore]] and located on the mainland of [[Dustwallow Marsh]] just across the bridge from the citadel itself. The tower acts as its name suggests, watching the comings and goings on the road to Theramore.
